PLAN "12-Week Metabolic Reset: Fat Loss & Glycaemic Control"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Improve insulin sensitivity and reduce body fat through progressive resistance and aerobic training"
  GOAL secondary endurance:
    name "Enhance cardiovascular efficiency and fasting glucose regulation"
  GOAL tertiary nutrition:
    name "Stabilise postprandial glucose via structured low-glycaemic nutrition protocol"

NUTRITION_PROTOCOL
  FRAMEWORK "Low-Glycaemic, High-Protein, Moderate-Carbohydrate"
  NOTE "Client is on Metformin. Coordinate all dietary changes with her prescribing physician or endocrinologist before programme start. Monitor for GI side effects of Metformin when increasing fibre intake."

  CALORIES
    target_deficit 300..400 kcal_per_day
    NOTE "Aggressive deficits are contraindicated — rapid weight loss can worsen insulin resistance and increase hypoglycaemia risk. A modest deficit supports fat loss while preserving lean mass."

  MACROS
    protein 1.6..1.8 g_per_kg_bodyweight
      NOTE "High protein preserves muscle during deficit, increases satiety, and has minimal effect on postprandial glucose. Distribute across 4 meals minimum."
    carbohydrate 35..40 percent_of_calories
      NOTE "Prioritise low-GI sources only: oats, legumes, sweet potato, brown rice, quinoa, non-starchy vegetables, berries. Avoid refined carbohydrates, white bread, sugary drinks, fruit juice, and high-GI fruits."
    fat 30..35 percent_of_calories
      NOTE "Emphasise monounsaturated and omega-3 sources: olive oil, avocado, oily fish, walnuts, flaxseed. Limit saturated fat to support cardiovascular health, which is a comorbidity risk in T2D."
    fibre 30..35 g_per_day
      NOTE "Soluble fibre (oats, legumes, psyllium) blunts postprandial glucose spikes. Increase gradually to avoid GI distress given Metformin use."

  MEAL_TIMING
    meals_per_day 4..5
    NOTE "Regular meal timing reduces glycaemic variability. No meal gaps longer than 4 hours during waking hours."
    pre_workout
      timing 60..90 minutes_before
      composition "Small mixed meal: 20-25g protein + 20-30g low-GI carbohydrate + minimal fat"
      example "Greek yoghurt with berries and a small handful of oats"
      NOTE "Avoid training fasted — Metformin combined with exercise can increase hypoglycaemia risk, especially in a caloric deficit."
    post_workout
      timing within_45_minutes
      composition "25-35g protein + 30-40g low-GI carbohydrate, low fat"
      example "Chicken breast with sweet potato, or a whey protein shake with banana"
      NOTE "Post-exercise glucose uptake window is enhanced in T2D. This is the optimal time for the largest carbohydrate serving of the day."
    evening_meal
      carbohydrate_cap 30g
      NOTE "Reducing evening carbohydrate load improves fasting glucose readings. Emphasise protein and non-starchy vegetables at dinner."

  HYDRATION
    target 2.5..3.0 litres_per_day
    NOTE "Adequate hydration supports renal glucose clearance. Avoid sugary drinks and fruit juices entirely. Unsweetened tea and black coffee are acceptable."

  FOODS_TO_AVOID
    - "Refined sugars and added sugars in all forms"
    - "Sugary beverages including fruit juice, sports drinks, flavoured water"
    - "White bread, white rice, white pasta"
    - "High-GI breakfast cereals"
    - "Alcohol — raises triglycerides, disrupts glucose regulation, and interacts with Metformin to increase lactic acidosis risk"
    - "Processed meats high in saturated fat"
    - "Trans fats and partially hydrogenated oils"

  SUPPLEMENTS
    supplement vitamin_D3:
      dose 1000..2000 IU_per_day
      NOTE "T2D is associated with vitamin D deficiency. Check serum levels at baseline. Supports insulin sensitivity."
    supplement magnesium_glycinate:
      dose 200..400 mg_per_day
      NOTE "Magnesium deficiency is common in T2D and impairs insulin signalling. Take with evening meal."
    supplement omega_3:
      dose 2..3 g_EPA_DHA_per_day
      NOTE "Reduces systemic inflammation and cardiovascular risk. Take with food to reduce GI side effects."
    supplement whey_protein:
      dose 25..35 g_per_serving
      NOTE "Use to hit protein targets if whole food intake is insufficient. Choose unsweetened, low-carbohydrate formulations."
    NOTE "All supplements should be reviewed by her physician. Metformin long-term use depletes B12 — request B12 serum test at baseline and monitor annually."

  GLUCOSE_MONITORING_GUIDANCE
    NOTE "Encourage client to self-monitor blood glucose if her physician approves. Ideal targets: fasting 4.0-7.0 mmol/L, 2hr postprandial below 8.5 mmol/L. Log glucose readings alongside training sessions to identify exercise-glucose response patterns."
    pre_exercise_check
      NOTE "If pre-exercise glucose is below 5.0 mmol/L, consume 15g fast-acting carbohydrate before training and recheck. If above 14.0 mmol/L and client feels unwell, defer training and contact physician."

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 — Foundation: Movement Quality and Metabolic Activation" (4 weeks):
    NOTE "Weeks 1-4 focus on movement pattern competency, establishing training habit, and initiating metabolic adaptation. Loads are moderate. RPE is deliberately conservative to allow recovery and avoid post-exercise hypoglycaemia."

    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Full Body Resistance A":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x20..30 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

      DAY Wednesday training 35m "Steady-State Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          NOTE "Moderate-intensity steady-state cardio. Target 60-70 percent max heart rate. This zone maximises fat oxidation and improves insulin sensitivity without excessive cortisol response."
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
        cardio:
          cycling 25m intensity moderate

      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Resistance B":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          split_squat 3x10 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          incline_press 3x12 rpe 5 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..30 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

    WEEK 2:

    WEEK 4:
      NOTE "Deload week. Reduce volume by 40 percent. Maintain movement quality. Allow physiological adaptation and glycaemic stabilisation."

  PHASE "Phase 2 — Development: Progressive Overload and Metabolic Conditioning" (4 weeks):
    NOTE "Weeks 5-8 introduce upper/lower split, increase training frequency to 4 days, add interval cardio to further improve insulin sensitivity, and progress loads systematically. RPE climbs to 7-8."

    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Lower Body":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 4x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m

      DAY Tuesday training 60m "Upper Body":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 4x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:

      DAY Thursday training 40m "Interval Cardio":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        NOTE "Interval protocol: 30 seconds moderate-high effort, 90 seconds low effort. Repeat 10 rounds. Total work interval 10 minutes. This protocol significantly improves insulin sensitivity and GLUT-4 expression. Monitor for hypoglycaemia post-session."
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
        cardio:
          cycling 30m intensity interval

      DAY Saturday training 60m "Lower Body B":

          glute_bridge 3x15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds

    NOTE "Weeks 9-12 push intensity to RPE 8-9, introduce supersets to increase metabolic demand and EPOC, and consolidate all adaptations. Nutrition compliance is critical in this phase. Aim for measurable HbA1c improvement by week 12."
